olivia-cust: Quick Q for presales - can Redwood do BYOK with customer CloudHSM, rotate KEKs every 4h, and keep p50 token latency under ~15ms for our realtime matching service? Need attestation docs + per-key audit lines for SOC2.
kai-sales: yes we can, but need a short POC. tradeoffs: caching unwrapped keys lowers latency but increases in-memory surface. we'll scope. :handshake:
harry-se: two POC modes: (1) key-proxy sidecar (cache TTL short, mem-lock) — best latency; (2) direct KMS unwrap on each session — easiest security but higher p50.
harry-se: example sidecar knobs: cache_ttl=60s, max_cached_keys=10, mem_lock=true. will test rotate cron "0 */4 * * *".
nora-security: auditors want HSM attestation cert, signed proof-of-possession, and per-op logs (wrap/unwrap, key_id, ts, principal). we can provide schema and sample files.
olivia-cust: can you show one sample audit line we can ingest?
harry-se: sample single-line JSON for SIEM: {"ts":"2026-11-02T11:05:03Z","event":"unwrap","key_id":"cust/prod/kek-01","req_id":"r_9876","principal":"svc/matcher"}
kai-sales: POC plan (3 weeks): kickoff & FW/attest exchange, deploy sidecar in staging + perf run, rotation stress (4h cadence x72h), deliver logs & cost projection, go/no-go.
kai-sales: action items: @harry-se perf harness + unwrap metrics, @nora-security attach attest + log schema, @olivia-cust confirm peak QPS and FIPS need.
deploy-bot: deploy-status: key-proxy v1.0 rolled to stg-a at 2026-11-02T11:12:20Z :rocket:
olivia-cust: thanks — we'll confirm QPS today. if POC shows cache_ttl=60s meets latency and audit requirements, we can proceed to SOW. :thumbsup:
